name: non-soap-payload-rejected-with-fault
description: cxf:proxy-service payload=envelope only accepts SOAP envelopes: a non-SOAP XML body is answered with a SOAP fault (HTTP 500) and nothing is sent to ShopService.

source.reference: proxying-a-soap-api/src/main/app/soap-api-proxy.xml (cxf:proxy-service doc:name="Check WSDL" payload=envelope in front of the http:request); proxying-a-soap-api/README.md ('validates the request against the WSDL')
